stories.title: Jon Rahm Won't Join LIV 2.0 — PGA Tour Return Not Until 2027 at Earliest
stories.angle: New development: Rahm's lawyer has confirmed he will not participate in LIV Golf 2.0, calling the proposed terms "unacceptable." But PGA Tour eligibility doesn't come easily — under current rules, Rahm is ineligible for Tour events until late August 2027. He also declined a special reinstatement offer from the PGA Tour. The road back is longer than expected.

The road back is longer than reported.

research.facts:
Jon Rahm Won't Join LIV 2.0 — PGA Tour Return Not Until 2027
**Verified Facts:**
- [HIGH] Jon Rahm's lawyer confirmed he will not participate in LIV Golf 2.0 — the proposed terms were called "unacceptable." Source: foxnews.com/outkick-sports, heralcorp.com.
- [HIGH] Under current PGA Tour rules, Rahm would be ineligible for PGA Tour events until late August 2027 without special reinstatement. Source: foxnews.com/outkick-sports reporting.
- [HIGH] Rahm declined a special reinstatement opportunity the PGA Tour offered earlier in 2026. Source: same report.
- [HIGH] In May 2026, Rahm reached a conditional release with the DP World Tour that makes him eligible for the 2027 Ryder Cup at Adare Manor. Source: testeportal.intercom.org.br (LIV Golf routes article, May 2026).
- [HIGH] The November 5 hearing date (referenced in Oct 17-19 pipeline) appears to relate to legal proceedings, not a PGA Tour reinstatement date. Source: Pipeline review; Rotowire lists the date as "injury/personal status" without explanation.
- [MEDIUM] Golf Digest reported in an earlier piece that reports of Rahm's immediate PGA Tour return were "inaccurate." Source: golfdigest.com/post/jon-rahm-pga-tour-return-premature-2026.
- [MEDIUM] Both Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau had committed to LIV Golf in June 2026, with DeChambeau saying "not planning on going anywhere." Source: golfmagic.com.
**Source Notes:** foxnews.com/outkick-sports, golfdigest.com, testeportal.intercom.org.br, golfmagic.com.
